import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from src.task_store import TaskStore

class TaskStoreTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_crud_survives_reopening_the_store(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "tasks.json"
            first = TaskStore(path)
            task_id = first.create("Draft report")
            self.assertEqual(first.list_tasks(), [{"id": task_id, "title": "Draft report"}])
            reopened = TaskStore(path)
            self.assertTrue(reopened.update_title(task_id, "Review report"))
            again = TaskStore(path)
            self.assertEqual(again.list_tasks(), [{"id": task_id, "title": "Review report"}])
            self.assertTrue(again.delete(task_id))
            self.assertEqual(TaskStore(path).list_tasks(), [])

    def test_distinct_tasks_survive_independent_changes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "tasks.json"
            store = TaskStore(path)
            first = store.create("First")
            second = store.create("Second")
            self.assertNotEqual(first, second)
            reopened = TaskStore(path)
            self.assertEqual(reopened.list_tasks(), [{"id": first, "title": "First"}, {"id": second, "title": "Second"}])
            self.assertTrue(reopened.update_title(first, "Changed"))
            self.assertTrue(TaskStore(path).delete(first))
            self.assertEqual(TaskStore(path).list_tasks(), [{"id": second, "title": "Second"}])

    def test_unknown_ids_are_reported_without_mutation(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            store = TaskStore(Path(directory) / "tasks.json")
            self.assertFalse(store.update_title("missing", "x"))
            self.assertFalse(store.delete("missing"))
            self.assertEqual(store.list_tasks(), [])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
